verdict.rationale: Sprinto's API reference documents custom-integration push APIs, integration monitoring, and framework-health/vendor-data APIs. These give the product its own programmatic interface, so scripts or CI jobs could push data and read compliance status without the UI. The evidence is only page titles, though: nothing documents a CLI, CI pipeline integration, or headless run mode, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented CLI or CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action or compliance gate), API auth and usage details for unattended runs, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
